target: Gitを入れたがコマンドを打ったことがない人
catch_en: Record it, read it, revert it
description_en: A course where you work through all three yourself: recording, reading, and reverting. You save your work with add and commit, check the current state with status, log, and diff, and safely go back with restore.
target_en: People who have installed Git but have never run a command
catch: 記録して、読んで、戻せる
description: 記録する・読む・戻すの3つを自分の手で通すコース。add と commit で作業を残し、status・log・diff で状態を確かめ、restore で安全に元へ戻せるようになります。
